question: According to Census of India 2011, what is the percentage of Hindu population in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**79.8%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, the percentage of **Hindu population** in India is **79.8%**.
 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years by the **Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner** under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Hindus constitute the largest religious group in India, making up nearly **four-fifths** of the total population.
 
• The **census data** is crucial for planning and policy-making by the government.
 
• Other major religious groups enumerated in the census include **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains,** and others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Census of India**__

 
 
• The **first census** in India was conducted in **1871**.
 
• The **latest census** was conducted in **2011**, and the next is scheduled for **2021**.
 
• The census provides a comprehensive account of the country's **demographic, social, and economic data**.
 
• The data collected includes information on **population, housing, literacy, employment, religion, and migration**.
